public.text: The subsection is extremely brief relative to the complexity of the interoperability requirements. It states that requirements should be testable but does not identify the minimum interoperability conformance artefacts.
public.suggestedRevision: List the required artefacts: implementation guides, profiles, capability statements, terminology packages, test cases, test data, validators, simulators, security test requirements, certification rules, and versioned conformance statements.
